'''Fungal Rock''' is a cave in the northeastern wall of [[Un'goro Crater]]. It is inhabited by [[gorilla]]s, and is also where one can find [[A-Me 01]], [[Karna Remtravel]]'s mechanical ape.

==List of Un'goro gorillas==
*{{RaceIcon|Gorilla|Small}}[[Un'Goro Gorilla]] (49-51)
*{{RaceIcon|Gorilla|Small}}[[Un'Goro Stomper]] (50-52)
*{{RaceIcon|Gorilla|Small}}[[Un'Goro Thunderer]] (51-53)
*{{RaceIcon|Gorilla|Small}}[[U'cha]] (55)
*{{RaceIcon|Gorilla|Small}}[[Neutral|A-Me 01]] '''mechanical'''
*{{RaceIcon|Gorilla|Small}}[[Uhk'loc]] '''rare''' (52-53)
